title: Generate Shape Series (VisualElements)

scenarios.title: Generate Shape Series applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Generate Shape Series (BtnSeriesGenerator) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Series Generator auto-fit scaling and item placement are pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The required series extent is computed per direction (items plus gaps, matrix columns capped by the item count and rows ceiled, zero extent for an unknown direction); the auto-fit scale shrinks only on the binding axis, never enlarges and guards zero requirements; each item is placed in a horizontal or vertical run by item size plus spacing and a matrix wraps every matrixColumns-th item into the next row, with a columnless matrix and an unknown direction anchoring every item at the start.
